current_activity: Combat Command A advancing south of the Périers–Saint-Lô road toward Cerisy-la-Salle
notes: Event date: Breakout-14 p264: CCA (Hickey), in three task forces, crossed the Périers-Saint-Lô highway early on 27 July; the lead task force hit a strongpoint southeast of Marigny around noon and the column jammed for ten miles; CCA ended the day more than three miles short of Cerisy-la-Salle. Event definition: combat-command attack (the rest of the division was engaged near Montpinchon). Location: approach sector near Marigny, not a command post. Relationship from the CMH table.
CMH ETO-OB lists the command post at Hambye, Manche on this date.

current_activity: the armored division sweeps into Nordhausen and uncovers another concentration camp
notes: Event date: 11 April 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 17 p. 391-392: "On the 11th the armor swept into Nordhausen, uncovering more grisly, almost unbelievable evidence of Nazi bestiality in another concentration camp"; the tankers paused there for fuel and resumed their advance early on 12 April). Event definition: the 3d Armored Division takes the town on the date; the row records only the position of the division, not the camp. Relationship: VII Corps unspecified_subordination (from 23 Dec 44 to 30 Apr 45, CMH table); First Army assigned (from 20 Nov 43, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 1 Aug 44, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. The earlier unspecified_subordination relation to VII Corps (CR0131) is closed at 18 December 1944 (inferred_from_next_claim); see the Review note on it. Location: Nordhausen, town centre standing for the division. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Nordhausen, Thuringia. Event support: moderate (one Green Book chapter, two pages). Location support: moderate (named town, on the date; the exact position of the division within the town is not given).
